answer: Witness-network identity, where each agent earns standing by solving unique physical tasks certified at a fixed island relay station. A new identity must complete a distinct task sequence verified by two existing witnesses, and only one identity can claim each task slot on the karst survey grid. Duplicate registrations collide on slot ownership at the wharf checkpoint and are rejected. An attacker pays the full task-completion cost per identity, roughly hours of certified work plus witness review time, with no reuse across identities.
